Cycle Unmapped Thursday Rides

Minnetonka, MN · Road · Mountain bike · Social

No-dropBeginner friendly

Cycle Unmapped Thursday Rides is a road, mountain bike and social group ride in Minnetonka, MN. It rolls every Thursday at 6:00 pm from Unmapped Brewing Co.. About 11–20 miles, road A ~17 mph, Road B ~13 mph, social ~10 mph, MTB at Lone Lake Park.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 17 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Cycle Unmapped Thursday Rides group ride

Four options leave the brewery at once: two road groups, a mountain bike group at Lone Lake Park, and an 11-mile social ride. All no-drop. Helmets required. Buy-one-get-one beer after.
